# API Reference

#### The schemas, fields and code examples of every Doxis AI.dp endpoint.

The API Reference describes every endpoint of the Doxis AI.dp API. Each service below links to its own reference pages, where you can see the request and response schemas and try out example requests.

All requests are authenticated with an API key. If you do not have an API key yet, read the [Authentication](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/api/authentication) guide first.

### OpenAPI Specification

The OpenAPI Specification lists every endpoint of the Doxis AI.dp API in one place. You can browse it online, import it into tools like Postman or use it to generate an API client.

[View the OpenAPI Specification![external-link](<Base64-Image-Removed>)](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/api/swagger)
